C1.worst_defect: On a phone the hero lead under "Point of sale for Vendure" runs to 7 centred lines of large grey body text, and the till screenshot under it shows a truncated "Q..." column header in the cart table.

C2.worst_defect: Limitations is one flat list of 15 equal-weight bullets. The deal-breaker "Postgres only" sits near the bottom with the same weight as minor items, so the most important constraint is the hardest to find.

C3.worst_defect: The quick start's collapsed disclosures are labelled inconsistently ("Why these pairings" has no period, "How POS sales take stock." has one) and hide setup reasoning behind a click inside a 9-step page that is already dense.

C4.worst_defect: Limitations has no headings or grouping (data, payments, hardware, platform), so its right-hand "On this page" rail is empty. The docs overview ends with three "Next steps" cards and then a separate right-aligned "Quick start >" pager card, two different card styles stacked.

C5.worst_defect: "What it does today" is a 2×5 wall of ten identical grey cards. Only the first two carry links ("Read the acceptance test", "Read the 200-send test"), so the proven claims look no different from the rest and there is no visual hierarchy. Also: the docs sidebar's grey panel stops with a hard edge at about y=900, and the at-the-till payment screenshot has a roughly 420 px empty band in the cart pane.

C6.worst_defect: The inline code chip `packages/vendure-plugin/CHANGELOG.md` breaks across two lines into two chip fragments ("packages/vendure–" / "plugin/CHANGELOG.md"), and the ten home cards stack into a single column about three screens long.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse mobile flags about 51 KiB of unused JS and about 150 ms of render-blocking resources; LCP is 2.3 s on / and 2.4 s on /docs/quick-start, close to the 2.5 s threshold.

overall_worst.defect: The home "What it does today" section is a uniform 2×5 wall of ten equal-weight grey cards. Only the first two link to proof ("Read the acceptance test", "Read the 200-send test"), so the page's strongest evidence has no visual priority, and on a phone it becomes a three-screen single-column stack.
overall_worst.fix: Promote the two proven claims (offline sales, lands-once sends) to a featured pair of larger cards with their proof links, and set the other eight as a compact two-column checklist (icon plus one line each) that collapses to tight rows on a phone.
